thread:
deploy-bot: Starting header-routed canary: route 10% -> router-v2-green in eu-west-1. Canary endpoints healthy. Release notes: https://redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-21/router-v2a (header affinity experiment)

Aisha: quick question 1: are we using header-based session affinity (x-session-id) for this canary or cookie fallback?

Connor: primary affinity = x-session-id header. fallback = cookie if header not present. sticky scope limited to stateless lanes.

Diego: warmup job kicked off for router-v2. preload KV keys for common prefixes, job id: warmup-20260321-3.

Rina: enabling trace sampling 1% for router-v2 so we can compare end-to-end latency traces without noise.

infra-bot: Pre-deploy healthchecks: /health -> 200 (median 32ms), TLS handshake baseline within expected.

deploy-bot: 10% handoff complete. quick metrics: p50 stable, p95 +2ms, error rate +0.01% (within threshold).

Aisha: seeing a handful of 302s for requests missing Accept header. likely due to an edge rewrite rule. Not a router-v2 bug but will patch edge rule.

Connor: repro: curl -H "User-Agent: canary-test" -I https://frontend.eu-west1.redwood.ai returns 302 when Accept header omitted. fix proposed: add accept: */* default at edge layer.

Diego: note 1: KV cache hit ratio for router-v2 after warmup ~88% on the sample. Good.

Rina: I recommend holding on the 50% bump until edge rule change is live. we'll keep the canary at 10% and expand to 25% after patch verification.

deploy-bot: Planned progression: 10 -> 25 -> 50 -> 100 with 8m quiesce at each step. Auto-fallback to router-v1 enabled. Current state: PAUSED at 10% pending edge patch.

Aisha: adding a short playbook here:
- If error rate > 0.6% or p95 > baseline + 40ms: run `router set-weight --env eu-west1 --service frontend --target router-v1 --weight 100` and notify #incidents
- If QoS regressions: reduce weight to 5% and trigger additional warmup job
- If edge fixes confirmed: resume 25% then proceed per plan with 8m quiesce

Connor: pinning note: tagging this canary with pin "rev-2026-03-21-v2a" in router metadata so analytics map traces correctly. Remember to remove pin after 48h if stable.

infra-bot: @oncall-bot assigned Rina as primary for 90m post-rollout. pager windows active.

Diego: small anomaly at t+6m: one backend pool returned intermittent 504s (3 events). traced to worker autoscaler flapping. not router-v2. I've opened infra ticket INF-1287.

Rina: thanks. let's not conflate; keep canary paused until autoscaler is stable for 30m.

deploy-bot: Shift paused at operator request (Aisha). Auto-fallback remains active.

Aisha: added a customer-impact broadcast draft in #customer-impact in case we need to notify; will only send if rollback occurs.

Connor: operational command snippet for rollback and quick restore: 
```
# emergency full rollback
router set-weight --env eu-west1 --service frontend --target router-v1 --weight 100 --reason "rollback: canary anomalies"
# remove pin after stable run
router clear-pin --env eu-west1 --service frontend --pin "rev-2026-03-21-v2a"
```

Diego: monitoring traces and cache hit heatmap. will report back in 15m.

Rina: decision checkpoint at 6790026155 (+20m). if autoscaler healthy and edge rule patched, plan to resume to 25% then 50%.

oncall-bot: Rina is primary, Aisha secondary for the next 90m. Playbook pinned to thread.

deploy-bot: Thread pinned for visibility. I'll post final resume/rollback logs here when automation runs. :mag:
